offerings.name: s.jina.ai (Reader API for web search and SERP)
offerings.pricing: 按 token 计费: Every request costs a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10,000 tokens; Standard key $0.050/1M tokens, Premium key $0.045/1M tokens
offerings.price_basis: Standard key 档 (1B tokens, $0.050/1M tokens), 每次搜索请求固定消耗 10,000 tokens 起机械换算 ($0.0005/次)
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens! (Toy Experiment 10 Million Tokens, Free, Non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC))
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果 (SERP): 返回 top five results 的 URL、标题与内容, 每条为 clean, LLM-friendly text
offerings.note: 原文: "prepend https://s.jina.ai/?q= to your query, and Reader will search the web and return the top five results with their URLs and contents". RPM: 无 key 100 / 免费 key 100 / Premium key 1000; 平均延迟 2.5s; 支持 GET/POST。Premium 档按 $0.045/1M tokens 折合约 $0.45/1k 次。
